marker.purpose: Whiteboard annotations and planning notes only.

motion.name: scrub
motion.purpose: Services column, drawn line, project masks, contact scene.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:48px; padding:0 1.4rem; border-radius:2px; background:#20201d; color:#fff; font:600 0.95rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .2s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#000; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #20201d; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: CTA Button
components.description: The one conversion action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 1.4rem; border-radius:2px; background:#e2a300; color:#20201d; font:600 0.95rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .2s; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background:#f1c23b; } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #20201d; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Form field with a label above and an underline only.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; font:500 0.82rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#20201d; } .ds-field input { border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #b9b6ad; padding:8px 0 9px; font:400 1rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; background:transparent; } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#20201d; box-shadow:0 1px 0 0 #20201d; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { box-shadow:0 2px 0 0 #e2a300; }

components.name: Phase Chip
components.description: Radio chip for the project phase.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:36px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #c9c6bc; border-radius:2px; font:400 0.88rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#20201d; } .ds-chip.is-on { background:#20201d; color:#fff; border-color:#20201d; } .ds-chip.is-on::before { content:''; width:6px; height:6px; margin-right:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#e2a300; }

components.name: Open Fact
components.description: Marks an unconfirmed fact instead of inventing it.
components.css: .ds-open { color:#6e6c65; text-decoration:underline dashed #b88400; text-underline-offset:4px; font:400 0.95rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Drawn Line
components.description: Scroll-drawn 1.5px ink line with a 90° bend and a ginstergelb head.
components.html: <svg class="ds-line" viewBox="0 0 240 120"><path d="M10 60 H200 V116" /><path class="c" d="M188 60 V72 H200" /><circle cx="200" cy="100" r="4.5" /></svg>
components.css: .ds-line { width:240px; } .ds-line path { fill:none; stroke:#20201d; stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-line .c { stroke-width:1; } .ds-line circle { fill:#e2a300; }

narrative.northStar: A planning surface that becomes a building
narrative.overview: One continuous architectural drawing: whiteboard, chair-width column, a ruler-drawn line that turns into the projects, and two people who finally turn to face the visitor.

rules.name: The Rare Yellow Rule
rules.body: Ginstergelb marks objects and points, never regions.

rules.name: The Honest Blank Rule
rules.body: Unconfirmed facts render as marked open fields, never invented.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Handwriting annotates; it never states the offer.

dos: Do scrub motion with scroll and render final states under reduced motion.
Do keep content visible without JavaScript.
donts: Don't use cards, gradients, glass, eyebrows or UI shadows.
Don't invent testimonials, facts or titles.
